headline: Reserve Bank of India Accepts Full ₹2,000 Crore Bids for State Bond Auction
summary: The Reserve Bank of India completed a yield-based auction for state government securities, accepting ₹1,000 crore each for Assam and Bihar bonds at cut-off yields up to 7.96%.
why: State Development Loans (SDLs) form a significant segment of India's sub-sovereign debt market.
